title: Christmas in Storyland
summary: "Christmas in Storyland" edited by Maud Van Buren and Katharine Isabel Bemis is a collection of juvenile Christmas stories written in the early 20th century. Each story is designed to capture the spirit of the holiday, likely appealing to families seeking read-aloud material or inspiring joyful discussions during the festive season. The subsequent tales maintain this heartwarming tone, conveying various encounters around Christmas, from the spirit of giving in a Montana ranch to the meaningful lessons of belief, kindness, and community during the holiday season.
